div.div: 12 اِجْشَوْشِبُو accord. to some, or اِخْشَوْشِبُوا accord. to others, occurs in a trad. of 'Omar; (TA in art. خشب;) [and J says, and so Az accord. to the TA,] the former, if used like the latter, is not improbably correct; but I have not heard it. (S.) [See art. خشب.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
